description: Register of AI-generated imagery committed under public/assets/generated/. Enforced by scripts/maintenance/check-generated-imagery.ps1: every image file in that directory must have exactly one entry here, and every entry must name a file that exists.

rules.permitted: non-person subjects only, on every content surface (ADR-027 section 1)
rules.prohibited: generated people, faces, figures and avatars (ADR-027 section 2)

schema.path: path relative to public/, e.g. assets/generated/hero-lilongwe.png
schema.subject: short description of the non-person subject

provenance.prompt_sha256: SHA-256 of the prompt; the prompt text is not committed
provenance.generated_at: ISO-8601 date the asset was generated
provenance.edited_by: human who post-processed the asset to brand
provenance.post_processing: short description of the palette or grade applied
